items.name: Amounts in mixed currencies
items.statement: One amount column holds several currencies; sums are wrong unless converted.

items.name: Daily snapshot next to events
items.statement: Snapshot rows and event rows have different grain; they must not be summed together.

items.name: Refunds stored as negative amounts
items.statement: Negative lines are refunds; totals must net or separate them.

items.name: Stock balance versus flow
items.statement: On-hand quantity is a point-in-time stock; moves are flow. Summing stock over time is wrong.

items.name: Two overlapping pools
items.statement: The same members sit in both pools; adding the pools double counts.

items.name: Dev data table
items.statement: Tiny, stale, synthetic-looking rows are not business data and must be excluded.
